text:
maya: heads up — ap-se1 is seeing a surge of tiny GPU pods stuck Pending. single-gpu jobs mostly, scheduler logs show conflicting claim IDs (claimed by different node). looks like a claim-drift between warmpool and kubelet detach.
henry: which pool? warmpool-gpu-small? can you paste the bind log lines?
maya: yes warmpool-gpu-small. snippet: ```I0312 14:02:12.123 scheduler binding pod/job-92 -> warm-node-17 (claim_id=abc vs live=def)```
anika: claim_id mismatch usually means node still holding lease or kubelet hasn't finished detach. we shortened the warm pool drain window yesterday, right?
henry: we moved drain 5m -> 30s to speed scaling. that could explain races where scheduler sees node as free while kubelet cleanup still in progress.
sre-lead: symptom: fragmentation and lots of tiny pods bouncing; plus transient evictions when the original holder returns. increases retries and egress churn.
anika: quick mitigation: revert drain back to 5m and add a lifecycle taint like gpu-release=pending:NoSchedule for ~2m on nodes after rejoin so scheduler won't reuse immediately.
maya: @henry can you roll that change? also add a metric to surface claim_id mismatch counts.
henry: on it. patching warmpool-autoscaler to 5m and adding post-rejoin taint hook. will also enable scheduler metric.
ops-bot: deploy start: warmpool-autoscaler v2.3.1 by henry — canary ap-se1 10%
maya: opened INFRA-2213 to instrument kubelet detach latency and attach traces: https://our-boards/INFRA-2213
henry: note: reverting drain ups idle pool-minutes ~12% for this pool, estimate +6% monthly spend. cheaper than user-level evictions though.
sre-lead: agree short-term revert + taint. mid-term: add a small backoff in scheduler on claim_id mismatches (hold 10s and requery node state) and add strict bind-consistency check to avoid double-claim.
anika: drafting scheduler PR for the 10s hold/backoff and consistency check.
maya: plan summary: (1) revert drain to 5m + taint hook (henry) (2) scheduler hold/backoff PR (anika) (3) kubelet detach telemetry (INFRA-2213) (4) monitor pending counts, eviction-rate, and cost delta (maya).
henry: canary rolled successfully, ramping to 100% in ap-se1 now.
ops-bot: deploy success: warmpool-autoscaler v2.3.1 rolled to 100% in ap-se1
maya: pending counts dropping already, will watch 30m. :thumbsup:
sre-lead: when stable, capture postmortem blurb and tradeoff calc for warmpool sizing vs evict/retry costs.
anika: PR draft up for scheduler hold, pinging for review.
henry: thanks everyone, keeping thread here for followups and metrics.
